label: EU
allocation_intro: Choose a scenario share of annual final electricity consumption.
scenario_sentence_template: Allocating {share} of {countryName}'s annual final electricity consumption to this scenario would provide an equivalent yearly energy budget for {profiles} configured AI-worker profiles.
comparison_sentence_template: Comparison: {profiles} configured profiles require {twh} TWh/year, equivalent to {share} of {countryName}'s annual final electricity consumption.
required_energy_sentence_template: This scenario requires {twh} TWh/year for {profiles} configured AI-worker profiles, equivalent to {energyMultiple} times {countryName}'s annual final electricity consumption. This is a beyond-total-electricity thought experiment, not an allocation.
truth_boundary: EU records are source candidates from Eurostat annual final electricity consumption. They are not promoted runtime data.

label: United States
allocation_intro: Choose a scenario share of annual retail electricity sales. This EIA metric excludes direct use.
scenario_sentence_template: Allocating {share} of {countryName}'s annual retail electricity sales to this scenario would provide an equivalent yearly energy budget for {profiles} configured AI-worker profiles.
comparison_sentence_template: Comparison: {profiles} configured profiles require {twh} TWh/year, equivalent to {share} of {countryName}'s annual retail electricity sales.
required_energy_sentence_template: This scenario requires {twh} TWh/year for {profiles} configured AI-worker profiles, equivalent to {energyMultiple} times {countryName}'s annual retail electricity sales. This is a beyond-total-electricity thought experiment, not an allocation.
truth_boundary: US records are source candidates from EIA retail sales to ultimate customers. They exclude direct use and are not promoted runtime data.
